translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Kabilia deli mina Siria

Guyau Benadadi guyoula Siria ikouguguli komwaidona la tokabilia, deli goli kasi topilasi tailuwotolu taiyu tuwoli gweguya deli si wosa toyo si waga kaibibiu ikatuwakedasi ilosi, ivaulaisi ivapataisi Sameria, e ikabiliaisi mavilouna.
E matauna iwitali touwata ilosi ovalu ilukwaisi guyau Eyabi guyoula Isireli kawasi, “Mwa guyau Benadadi la biga eilivala
yoku bukukwasali m siliba, m goula, m kukova deli litumwa topapeula baisa matauna.”
Eyabi ivitakauloki kawala, “Tauwau bukulukwaisi ulo guyau Benadadi, bogwa lakabwaili ibodi matauna bikauwaigu deli komwaidona avaka avaka ulo guguwa.”

E igau oluvi touwata matausina ikaimilavausi baisa Eyabi deli karaiwaga kwetuwoli metoya baisa Benadadi. “Ka lawitali biga leiwoiyaisi mwada bukukwasali m siliba, m goula, m kukova deli litumwa baisa yeigu.

Mitaga ka, baisa tuta bawitali ulo kumatoula biwaisi bisuvalaisi m ligisa deli tosikwawa si bwala e bikauwaisi komwaidona guguwa makwaisina idokaisi saina mwau mipusi. Matausina nabwaia biwaisi makala kalu wala lagaila lalilivala.”

E guyau Eyabi idou komwaidona tokugwala valu e ikaibiga kawala, “Ka kugisaisi tau matauna magila biyogagaidasi. Matauna iwitali biga baisa yeigu ikominimani magila ulo kukova deli litugwa, ulo siliba deli goula, e yeigu bogwa lakabwaili.”
E tokugwala valu deli tomota komwaidona ivitakaulokaisi kawasi, “Gala bukukwabikuwoli matauna; gala bukutagwala.”

Mapaila Eyabi iluki Benadadi la touwata kawala, “Kulukwaisi ulo guyau matauna la biga kwaimatala bogwa lakabwaili, mitaga gala batagwala bakabikuwoli la biga kwaiyuwela.” E touwata isilavaisi ilosi e ikaimilivausi tuvaila imaiyaisi
la biga Benadadi kawala, “Yeigu bawoi tokabilia bidubadu bikatudidaimisi mi valu e bikauwaisi komwaidona guguwa. Ibodi ulo yaubada minasina bikatumataigusi kidamwa gala bavagi makawala!”
E guyau Eyabi ivitakauloki kawala, “Kulukwaisi guyau Benadadi, tokabilia mokwita bikamnomwana avai tuta kabilia biwokuva, mitaga gala biluvabogwa wodola.”

E tuta makwaina Benadadi deli sala matausina guyousi valu ituwoli, imomomsi osi buliyoyova, Benadadi ibani la biga mapula baisa Eyabi. Matauna ikaraiwogi la tokabilia bikatubaiasasi paila bikabiliaisi valu mavilouna mapaila ileiyasi kabasi.

Oluvi, taitala tovitoubobuta ilokaia guyau Eyabi e iluki matauna, kawala, “Guyau eilivala, gala bukukukoli mabudona tokabilia saina bidugaga! Yam lagaila bavigakaim bukutomgaga odubasi e bukunikoli yeigu wala Guyau.”

E Eyabi ikatupoi kawala, “Availa bivamitali kabilia?” E tovitoubobuta ivitakauloki kawala, “Matausina tubovaula valu mavilousina si tokabilia matausina osikowasi kumatoula bivamitalaisi goli.” E guyau ikatupoi kawala, “Availaga bikugwai budumwaidona tokabilia?” E tovitoubobuta ivitakauloki kawala, “Mayokula.”

Mapaila guyau idou imaisi komwaidosi tubovau valu mavilousina si tokabilia matausina osikowasi si kumatoula, kasi bawa tailakatuyu tailuwotolu taiyu. E tuvaila matauna idou mina Isireli tokabilia komwaidona kasi bawa iboda 7,000.
E kalasia itowota kabilia ivitouula, Benadadi deli sala matausina tailuwotolu taiyu bogwa eimommatasi osi buliyoyova.
Mabudona tokabilia tubovaula valu ivamatalaisi. E matutona tovakawali Benadadi eiwitali eilosi ikaimilavausi ilukwaisi matauna paila budotala tokabilia mina Sameria bogwa leimaisi.
Matauna ikaraiwaga kawala, “Gala wala avaka kaina leimaisi paila kabilia, kaina paila vasosu mitaga kukwatumataisi wala.”
E mabudona tubovau eivamitalaisi tokabilia e otuboulosi komwaidona tokabilia mina Isireli,
e availa wala biyokavati guma Siria e ikatumati. E mina Siria isakaulasi, igisaimwaisiga mina Isireli ibokavilaisi, mitaga Benadadi isila ola wosa isakaula, deli mimilisi sala.
Igisaim guyau Eyabi ibwakavila wala, e iyokavati wosa minasina deli waga kaibibiu makaisina, e matauna imtuligigai matausina itomgaga odubasi mina Siria.

Oluvi tovitoubobuta ilokaia guyau Eyabi e iluki kawala, “Kukwaimilivau kula kuvakikita m tokabilia, bukuleiya m tokabilia kukivituvatu bibwaina, paila uula talatova omilamala guyoula Asiria bimyuvau kabilia.”
Mina Siria lilouyuwela ikabiliasi

E guyau Benadadi la kumatoula ilukwaisi matauna kawasi, “Mina Isireli si yaubada minasina mesisikaisi wa koya, e baisa uula leitomgwagasi odabadasi. Mitaga kidamwa bitakabiliasi okabatau bitakalisauwaisi wala.
Baisa tuta kunagivau kaimapusi matausina tailuwotolu taiyu gweguya metoya osi karaiwaga e kusailiga touwovau kumatoula bikugwaiyaisi tokabilia.

Kukwatubiasi tokabilia budoveka kasi bawa makawala mabudona deli lokusakaulasi okabilia e wosa deli waga kaibibiu kasi bawa makawala wala. E bitakabiliaisi mina Isireli okabatau, e malilouna bitatomgwagasi odubasi.” E guyau Benadadi ikabwaili e ivagi avaka si nanamsa.
Avai tuta kweluvala milamala ibudoki idou komwaidona la tokabilia e ikatuwakedasi ilosi ovalu Apeki paila bikabiliaisi mina Isireli.

E mina Isireli bogwa ikatubaiasasi eililatu wala; matausina ikatuwakedasi boda budoyu e ibudaisi si kabeikau mitasi ikoulakaiwa mina Siria. Mina Isireli si tokabilia bitagisi kasi bidubadu makawala yuwoyu yuwokikekita yuwolela gota e matausina mina Siria imiliaki valu.

E tovitoubobuta ilokaia guyau Eyabi e iluki kawala, “Baisa makawala Guyau eilivala. ‘Paila mina Siria eilivalasi mwada yeigu natana minasina tokolu masisiki wa koya e gala okabatau, mapaila bavigakaim bukutomgagasi odubasi si tokabilia mabudona saina budoveka, e yoku deli m tomota bukunikolaisi yeigu Guyau!’”
E kwailima kwaiyu yam mina Siria deli mina Isireli ililatu wala osi kabeikau. E oyamla kwailima kwaiyuwela ivitouulasi kabilia, e mina Isireli ikatumataisi mina Siria kasi bawa 100,000.

Matausina ikabibwelakaisi isakaulasi ilosi ovalu Apeki, e valu kalila isigiyeila ikatumati kasi bawa 27,000. E Benadadi madeilila wala isakaula iwokaia ovalu makwaina e ila isupepuni kwaitala bwala otoutomla.

La kumatoula ilokaiasi matauna ilukwaisi kawasi, “Mwa bogwa lakanakaigalaisi guyousi Isireli tonokapisi. Ibodi bukutagwala bakasikamsi ma saigalasi deli yuwoyoula bakavigakaisi kama kuwasi, e kaina bininabwaila gala bikatumataim.”

Mapaila matausina isisikamsi si saigala e yuwoyoula ivigakaisi kasi kuwa, e ilokaiasi Eyabi ilukwaisi kawasi, “Mwa m touwata Benadadi ikayubabai baisa yoku paila bukukoli la momova.” E Eyabi ivitakauloki kawala, “Ki, matauna isisu tomomova ke? O bwaina! Matauna ivigaki makawala taitala bodagu!”

E Benadadi la kumatoula igigisasi wala avai kabotuvatusi bwaina bivagi, e avai tuta Eyabi ilivala kawala, “bodagu”, e matausina nani wala ikabwailisi, kawasi, “Bogwala yoku kawam matauna Benadadi bodam.” E Eyabi ikaraiwogi, kawala, “Kumiakaigusi matauna.” Avai tuta Benadadi iviloubusi, Eyabi idou matauna bimwena bilokaia isiwaisi ola waga kaibibiu.

E Benadadi iluki matauna kawala, “Mwa yeigu bakaimilivau basakaim valu mavilousina tamagu leiyouli metoya baisa tamam, e olopola Damasiko, yoku ibodi bukukwaluvitau m kwabogimwala bidubadu makawala goli tamagu leivigaki olopola Sameria.” E Eyabi ivitakauloki kawala, “Ka kidamwa bukuvagi avaka bogwa lokulivala, yeigu bogwa batanekwaim bukula.” E kasitaiyu wala ibigabwailasi e Eyabi itugwali Benadadi ila.
Tovitoubobuta ikamogi Eyabi
Metoya Guyau ola karaiwaga taitala tovitoubobuta metoya osi boda tovitoubobuta wala ikaraiwogi taitala sola tovitoubobuta wala biwaiya matauna. Mitaga matauna ipaiki,
mapaila iluki matauna kawala, “Paila lokukoulovi Guyau la karaiwaga e laiyoni bikamataim avai tuta bukusilavaigu.” E tuta matutona leisilavi matauna laiyoni ima ikamati matauna.
E matoulela matauna tovitoubobuta ilokaia taitala tuvaila iluki kawala, “Kuwaigu!” E tau matauna ikabikaula; iwaiya matauna saina minimani omigila.
Tovitoubobuta matauna ikatuduvidavi ikau karekwa ikapoli migila e ila itoli osiusiula keda itutuli guyoula Isireli bivalapula.

Avai tuta guyau ililoula emaima tovitoubobuta idou matauna kawala, “Mwa ulo guyau, okabilia wala taitala tokabilia iyosi taitala tilaula imiakaigu e ilukwaigu kawala, ‘Kuyamati tau matauna e kidamwa bisakaula kaimapula yoku bukukwaliga kaina bukumapu 3,000 siliba.’
Mitaga ayokaim wala paisewa ituwoli e tau matauna isakaula.” E guyau ivitakauloki kawala, “Ka bogwa lokukwamituli kam pakula titoulem, mapaila bogwa wala bukubodi makawala.”
E tovitoubobuta saina nanakwa ikisi karekwa miyana omigila, e guyau ivitoki tolosila matauna taitala metoya osi boda tovitoubobuta.

E matauna iluki guyau kawala, “Baisa makawala Guyau la biga, ‘Bogwa lakaraiwaga tau matauna bukukwatumati, mitaga yoku lokutugwali leisakaula. Mauula baisa kam pakula yoku bukukwaliga, e m tokwabilia bidoumsi wala paila uula leitugwalaisi la tokabilia leisakaulasi.’”
E guyau matauna deli wala la nokubukubu toyo la ninamwau ikaimilavau ovalu Sameria.
